verdict.rationale: Square publishes official SDKs (e.g. square-nodejs-sdk TypeScript library) with clear code examples, plus a broad set of documented APIs (Catalog, Inventory, Orders, Payments, Webhooks, Terminal) and a Sandbox for testing, and an official MCP server for agentic integration. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK quality/reliability and no public OpenAPI spec discoverable via probes.
